blocks.text: **Best farm so far:** launch Operation Iron Citadel, loot the Chang-san Air Base barracks and the three houses there, then leave without finishing it. One guide got Manuals almost every run.

**Season 1 guns:** unlocking one on the Battle Pass gives you its Manual: Cronen Osprey (assault rifle) at tier 16, CSG-35 (SMG) at tier 36, both free. Owning a blueprint from BlackCell, a store bundle or the Vault Edition also unlocks the base gun, which is how the M4 comes with BlackCell (Perimeter Lance).
Nothing new since Nov 8: the eleven key rooms written up Nov 8 to 10 had recipes and valuables but no Manuals.
No spot reported yet for: Han 86, Hyeon Burst, Oden, Axion, X-58 Nyx, Oris 8.6, Mosin-Nagant, Signal .50, Astaroth .57, Krait P68, Mojave .357.

blocks.text: **Samples for the X01 printer recipes:** SR-16 Bio Agent Sample is on the lab table in Deep Vault 406. Specter Fabric Sample is rare random loot inside X01; nobody has reported a fixed spot.

**Argonaut Armor without the Specter Fabric:** kill The Captain for a Deep Vault Access Card, hack the Core Room in the Deep Vault (northwest corner, lower levels) and take the suit from its display case. That's repeatable. X01 Orders page 5 also gives one, once. The Staff Emergency Exfil Keycard recipe is the X01 Orders page 4 reward.
**Nov 10 patch:** UAVs and Advanced UAVs can no longer be used inside X01. Killing players in there raises your Bounty Level more slowly (Nov 7).

**Resupply Run** (Season 1 event): find set items at points of interest and trade them for Self-Revive Kits and 3-Plate Carriers. Still not live or dated as of Nov 10; which items and where you trade haven't been reported.

rows: 25,000 to sell (Stash Weapon III and Bank X and XII need them)

blocks.text: **Scavenger Bonus (Nov 10):** if you die or miss exfil you now get some cash anyway, based on the value of what you had looted and how long you were deployed. Story Missions don't count. No amounts published.

**Hiding from UAVs (Nov 6):** Thermal Padding, Thermal Padding Pro and the Sedative Inhaler now hide you from UAVs and upgraded UAV Towers. An Advanced UAV still finds you. Mini Tracker's radius was cut slightly on Nov 10.
**Bank caps:** Start 100,000 · I 250,000 · II 500,000 · III 1M · IV 2M · V 5M · VI 10M · VII 25M · VIII 50M · IX 100M · X 250M · XI 500M · XII 1B · XIII 2B. Cash over the cap is lost.

**Levels that matter:** 10 Gunsmith · 15 third Operator · 25 Gunsmith 5% off · 37 3-Plate vest · 48 Self-Revive Kit recipe · 55 Disposable Parachute · 70 +18 item slots. Police Stations: D2, C4, F4, H5, G7. Compounds: Foxtrot B4, Charlie D4, Alpha E7, Bravo F8, Echo G7, Delta H4.

Loot spots, costs and prices come from fan sites and player reports, re-checked Nov 10, 2026. Season 1 says recipes and upgrade costs changed but hasn't listed the changes, so printer costs are from before Season 1. When the game disagrees with this app, trust the game and tell James.
DMZ Codex was one of these sources. On Oct 30 its site started sending visitors to scam pages, so the app no longer links to it.
